starting_commit_message: D4-A5 continuation freeze prospective shared plans

audit_defect_repaired.finding: verify_continuation_plan_freeze_gate compared R1 artifacts AND R2 artifacts against R1_HEAD. R2 artifacts did not exist at R1_HEAD, so valid R2 artifacts at the plan-freeze boundary were falsely reported as drift, blocking the real-repository plan-freeze verification after successful Phase P.

mechanical_confirmation.conclusion: None != valid R2 blob -> false historical drift

audit_defect_repaired.repair: The plan-freeze gate now uses the R6 per-stage baseline semantics via historical_baseline_drift(): A5 artifacts -> A5_STOP_HEAD, R1 artifacts -> R1_HEAD, R2 artifacts -> R2_HEAD, R3 artifacts -> R3_HEAD, R5 artifacts -> R5_HEAD. Later-stage artifact absence at an earlier stage is not drift; missing-at-owning-stage and changed-after-owning-stage both fail closed. The defective R1_HEAD common-baseline block was removed.

post_plan_lineage.R7_post_plan_retrieval_implementation_fr: post-plan retrieval implementation freeze commit identified only by Git (HEAD message exact, HEAD parent = plan-freeze); its stable SHA is persisted only at future Phase-R runtime
post_plan_lineage.future_raw_freeze: direct child of R7 (not yet created)

proves: R6 -> plan-freeze diff limited to manifest + raw plans
R7 message correct; parent = frozen plan-freeze HEAD
raw plans at R7 == raw plans at plan freeze

downstream_lineage_plumbing.raw_freeze_gate: parent(raw-freeze) = R7; raw plans at raw-freeze == raw plans at 12b5dc6; strict R7 -> raw-freeze allowlist {manifest, raw results}
downstream_lineage_plumbing.evaluator_preflight: proves R6 -> plan-freeze -> R7 -> raw-freeze with per-stage baselines, runner/test blob seal to R7, production immutability, and manifest cross-check
downstream_lineage_plumbing.minimal_scope: no schema migration; no rename of historical/raw-plan fields

scientific_non_scope.n014_pflueger_special_case: none; exposed Phase-P applicability outcomes do not influence implementation

execution_integrity_seal_amend.audit_finding: R7 historical-gate refactoring removed the previous clean-worktree/index seal: commit-to-commit Git checks could pass while Phase R or the evaluator consumed dirty worktree files (execute_phase_r reads the worktree raw plans; the evaluator reads the worktree raw results).
execution_integrity_seal_amend.repair_A: verify_phase_r_preflight begins with assert_clean_worktree (worktree AND index) before any other authorization check; READY_FOR_PHASE_R is impossible unless HEAD is a valid R7, the worktree/index are clean, the raw-plans committed blob is unchanged, the historical plan boundary is valid, and the production/scientific authorities are unchanged.
execution_integrity_seal_amend.repair_B: verify_continuation_raw_freeze_gate begins with assert_clean_worktree; verify_continuation_evaluator_preflight inherits the seal through its call chain (no duplicated checks).
execution_integrity_seal_amend.repair_C: R7_ALLOWED_REPAIR_FILES is exactly the 7-file R7 repair contract; evaluation/d4_a5_continuation_execution_manifest.json is excluded, so an R7 commit that modifies the continuation manifest is rejected by the Phase-R preflight repair-diff seal.
execution_integrity_seal_amend.historical_plan_freeze_verifier_unchange: verify_continuation_plan_freeze_gate stays head-independent (validates the immutable 12b5dc6 boundary from a later descendant HEAD) and gains no clean-worktree requirement.
execution_integrity_seal_amend.regression_tests: 7 added: dirty raw plans / dirty runner / staged modification at the Phase-R boundary; dirty raw results / dirty runner / staged modification at the raw-freeze-evaluator boundary; R7 manifest-diff rejection.
execution_integrity_seal_amend.zero_exposure: no analyzer, retrieval, embedding, reranker, QA, verifier, judge, evaluator execution, DB/Qdrant write, or Batch2 production activation
